facts.value: This module provides a deeper understanding of some of the less well known programming paradigms. In particular it will focus on central programming concepts such as abstraction and representation as well as concepts such as parallel and concurrent execution. Particular emphasis on newer and emerging programming languages and industry trends will be an essential aspect of this module.

metadata.chunk_title: Rationale and Purpose of the Module:

facts.value: Abstract Machines; Describing a Programming Language, Names and The Environment, Memory Management, Control, Abstraction; Models of concurrency and implementation.
